pages.purpose: Institution landing page (single role: Institution Admin). Reads every dataset draft from localStorage and derives status, totals, and activity; layout follows Figma Portal Delivery dashboard 24570:127550 (312 / 1fr / 1fr / 312 grid).
components: .portal-header (crest + Dubai Knowledge lockup, .portal-nav Dashboard/Submissions, .portal-tools: hidden demo pill, a11y pill, EN/AR pill, .tool-user account pill with .user-menu Log out)
.dash grid of .dash-card panels (radius 24, border outline)
.dash-card--hero highlights carousel (.hero-slide, .hero-dots, .hero-tag, .hero-open; 3 rotating notices, 7s autoplay, pause on hover)

.dash-card--tasks remediation queue (.segmented--pill .task-filter: Needs remediation / In progress / Not started / All; .task-list rows with ref HEDB-2026-nnn, name, cadence + field count, record count, status .chip, .task__go arrow; Show all N / Show fewer; container-query stacking)

.dash-card--profile institution card (.profile-cover photo, .profile-crest initials, .profile-name, .profile-meta Licensed 2025-26, .profile-facts dl: institution code, datasets submitted a of 46, records entered, records needing remediation, last submission relative time)
.dash-card--quick .quick-list (Start a submission, Continue where you left off, View a data report)
.dash-card--progress half-ring SVG .gauge with .legend and Semester & annual / Real-time .segmented--pill scope
.dash-card--calendar .months stacked bars Jan-Apr 2026 by cadence with .legend--wrap
.dash-card--analytics .meters (Datasets started, Records entered, Records needing remediation)
.dash-card--activity .feed of folded activity events (added/updated/deleted/imported/submitted) with relative time and count chip
.empty--inline states per filter, .toast-host
strengths: Nothing hard-coded: every figure is derived from dataset metadata plus saved drafts, so it reflects real submission state
Remediation queue ranks by severity (errors > in progress > untouched) and each row deep-links to the dataset form
Honest, filter-specific empty states; container queries keep task rows readable at large a11y page sizes
Carousel respects reduce-motion, exposes dots as tabs, pauses on hover
Half-ring gauge and stacked calendar are dependency-free inline SVG/CSS, themed with DS tokens
Full EN/AR with mirrored canvas wash, arrows, and RTL-aware grid; Arabic number formatting in fmt()
Activity log folds runs of the same action within 10 minutes and links back to the dataset
weaknesses: Single institution, single role; no KHDA Data or KHDA IT view, no role switch, no institution context
No due dates, deadlines, overdue/Delayed state, or reporting period (Fall/Winter/Spring) model; calendar windows Jan-Apr 2026 are hard-coded illustrative constants in export.js
Status vocabulary (new / progress / errors / submitted) does not match KHDA statuses (non-submitted / processing / needs correction / accepted) and has no channel (API vs portal upload)
No pipeline visibility: nothing shows iPaaS -> API Hub -> adapter -> Qlik DQ validation/profiling/processing; 'submitted' is only a local timestamp
No notifications feed, approval queue, API health, or credential status widgets; header has no bell or global search (tool-pill__badge and .tool-pill--search exist in CSS but are unused)
Institution identity is inferred from the most frequent institution code across drafts; 'Licensed 2025 - 26' and HEDB-2026-nnn references are invented constants, not KHDA facts
Analytics meters use an arbitrary 200-record denominator; gauge caption 'of 31 datasets' mixes scope with the 46 total shown elsewhere
No KPI tile row (Total 46 / Submitted / Non-submitted) comparable to competitor home; no leaderboard or readiness score
Hero slides are static marketing copy rather than data-driven announcements or deadline alerts
Screenshot dashboard.png shows Recent activity cut off below the fold at the 1100px capture height

pages.purpose: Catalogue of the 46 HEDB datasets as cards with search, favourites, sort, paging, whole-submission export, a dataset details side sheet, and the bulk-vs-form choose overlay. Follows Figma Services page 3578:78576.
components: .portal-header (same as dashboard)
.hero: centred .hero__title Submissions, .find 720px search box, .or-divider, .toggle-pills (.pill All datasets / Favourites)
.results__head: .results__count 'Showing 46 datasets', .results__tools (#exportAll .btn--outline Export everything, .control--sort select A-Z / Z-A / most fields)

.card-grid of .ds-card (emoji .ds-card__icon, .ds-card__actions report icon + .bookmark favourite, .ds-card__title, 3-line clamped .ds-card__desc, .ds-card__meta cadence .chip + field-count .chip--outline, .ds-card__foot View details .btn--outline .btn--card + Start submission .btn--primary .btn--card)
.results__foot with .results__info and .pager (arrows + numbered pages, 8 per page)

.sheet-backdrop / .sheet right side sheet 704px (dataset details): .sheet__title, .sheet-note about block, .modal__meta chips, .field-list table (Field name / Data type / Mandatory), .sheet__actions (Cancel, View data report, Start submission)
.choose-overlay blurred veil with .choose-card and two .choice cards (Bulk upload / Form submission), focus trap, arrow-key navigation, Escape/backdrop close
.empty state for no search hits, .toast-host
strengths: Search covers title, description, cadence, sheet name and every field name, multi-word AND matching
Details sheet lists every field with type and mandatory flag straight from the dictionary (matches competitor spec drawer)
Favourites persisted per user; export-everything workbook built offline via template.js with summary, register, analytics and one sheet per dataset
The 15 real-time datasets carry display names (Person Profile, Academic Program) rather than raw codes, beating competitor weakness 4
Choose overlay keeps the portal header crisp, traps focus, restores focus to the opener, and legacy choose.html links still land correctly
Responsive card grid 4/3/2/1 columns; RTL sheet slide-in direction flips
weaknesses: No grouping by subject area (Employees / Graduates / Institution / Programs & courses / Research & innovation / Students & applicants) or by frequency; competitor has grouped, flat and frequency views
Cards only, no table view; no per-dataset Due, Submission status, Freshness, Channel, or open-issue counts on the card
No filters by cadence, status, or reporting period; no reporting-period selector at all
Duplicate display titles (two 'Course Faculty', two 'Course Learning Outcomes') distinguished only by a cadence chip; real-time vs semester variants need explicit naming
Emoji icons are not DDS iconography and render inconsistently across OS fonts
8 per page yields 6 pages for 46 datasets; a grouped single page would scan faster
'Sort by most fields' is a developer convenience, not a user need; missing sort by due date / status
Choose overlay offers only Bulk upload and Form; the primary R1 channel (REST API via iPaaS) and the exception-approved portal-upload entitlement are not represented
Screenshot choose.png does not capture the overlay (identical to submissions.png except a disabled export button), so the plan needs a fresh render of that state
No bulk actions, no saved views, no export of the catalogue itself as a compliance register

pages.purpose: Legacy redirect stub. Immediately forwards ?sheet=<sheet> to submissions.html?choose=<sheet>, where choose.js opens the bulk-vs-form overlay. The old Figma step page (11058:260635) and selector panel (11063:261216) survive only as the overlay design.
components: Inline redirect script, fallback link text 'Taking you to Submissions'
strengths: Keeps old bookmarks and dashboard links working with no visible extra step
The replacement overlay pattern (blurred page behind, focused two-card panel) is reusable for any 'before we start' decision
weaknesses: No longer a page; the plan should treat 'choose' as a modal step, not a route
Choice is not remembered per dataset or per user, so it is asked every time
Does not gate the choice by entitlement (API-only institutions vs exception-approved upload institutions)

pages.purpose: Data entry for one dataset (?sheet=, optional &mode=bulk|form, &edit=<id>). Two-step Service Task flow: Enter records (sectioned form + records grid + template/upload/export) then Review and submit (read-only grid with totals + confirmation). Drafts persist per dataset in localStorage khda.hedb.<sheet>.v1.
components: .portal-header (Submissions active)
.service-header: .back-link Back to submissions, .title-bar with dataset .title-bar__headline and .link-icon actions (View data report, About this service)
.main 3-column layout: .lhs rail / .divider / .rhs panels

.step-progress (STEP 1 OF 2 label + .progress-track fill) and .stepper (.stepper__item current/done/warning/locked, .stepper__rail, .stepper__icon, .stepper__status chip, .stepper__title, chevron) with .stepper__sub section sub-steps (Identification / Classification / People and contact / Figures / Dates / Other details)
.dropzone (bulk mode): .dropzone__box drag-and-drop + .dropzone__side 3-step guide and Template button

#recordForm: .form-section groups, .form-grid of 320px .field (label with * or (Optional), .control text/number/email, .control--select with code - label options, .datefield + .datepicker popover, readonly derived fields), .field__error inline messages, .form-actions Clear / Previous section / Next section / Add record

.records: .records__header (headline + count .chip--outline + columns-shown .chip--neutral), .records__tools (.search, .segmented All/Valid/Errors, .tool-btn Template/Upload/Export), .table-wrap .data-table (sortable th, .mono code cells with .cell-sub descriptions, .has-error rows with .row-note error lines, .btn-actions row menu Edit/Delete), .empty with Load sample row, .pagination with page size select
Step 2 .review-block: search, read-only .data-table with tfoot totals, .checkbox 'I confirm that the information provided is accurate and complete'
.card-footer Back / Save & Exit / Next-Submit
.success-state (green check, 'Dataset Successfully Submitted', Back to data entry / Back to submissions)
.modal-backdrop .modal confirm dialog (delete, submit, about), .row-menu, .toast-host
strengths: Form, validation, grid columns, template, upload matching and export all come from schema.js metadata; 46 datasets, zero per-dataset code

Validation from the dictionary: mandatory, coded lists, whole/decimal numbers and minimums, text length, cross-field 'cannot exceed', date format and no-future, primary-key duplicates (26 datasets) or identical-row fallback (20 datasets)
Sectioned form with sub-steps in the rail; a section cannot be left with errors, and the first error is focused and scrolled into view

Excel template is a real OOXML workbook with dropdowns from named ranges, numeric/date/length validation, custom cross-field formulas, VLOOKUP-filled derived columns, frozen header, and a Field guide sheet; works offline
Upload accepts xlsx/xls/csv, claims each column once, converts Excel dates, skips duplicate keys, flags failing rows and reports matched columns
Grid search covers all fields including code descriptions; counts stay honest under filters; page size selectable
Stepper mirrors the Figma Vertical Stepper V2 with done/current/warning/locked states; the footer follows the Service Button Row
Draft autosave with Save & Exit toast, edit deep-link from the report grid, activity logging for the dashboard
Keyboard: row menu arrow keys, Escape everywhere, focus management on modals; RTL handled for select chevrons, date picker, error rail, toast
weaknesses: Only two steps; no maker-checker (Data Steward prepares, Approver signs off) and no 'send for approval' state; success copy claims 'sent for KHDA review' though no KHDA side exists

No submission journey tracker for the R1 pipeline (received -> API Hub auth/validation -> adapter stored -> DQ validation -> profiling -> processing -> accepted) and no server-side validation results panel; errors are only inline row notes
No version / resubmission history, no diff between versions, no audit trail of who changed what
No reporting-period selection at submission level (period is only a per-record field), no due date shown, no waiver/exception request
Only 8 of N columns shown with no column chooser; table min-width 1100 forces horizontal scroll on every dataset
No downloadable error report for a failed upload; no field-level help/dictionary drawer inside the form (the details sheet exists only in the catalogue)
Grid filter binding uses generic $$('.segmented button') selectors, so adding another segmented control to the page would cross-wire the filters
Row action button opens a menu for two items where inline icon buttons would be faster; 'About this service' reuses the confirm modal
Success-state icon uses non-DS greens (#4CAF50 / #2E7D32) and there is no celebration tray from the Figma pattern
SheetJS is loaded from a CDN for upload/export; offline fallback is CSV only

pages.purpose: Data report for one dataset (?sheet=): statistics tiles, grouped analytics bars, numeric totals, and the full data grid with search, sort, paging, export and an edit link back to the form. Everything derived from field metadata and the local draft.
components: .portal-header (Submissions active)
.service-header: .back-link, .title-bar (dataset title, .tool-btn Export data, .link-icon Open data entry), .report-sub description
.report-block Statistics: .stat-grid of .stat tiles (.stat__icon, .stat__label, .stat__value; .stat--accent for totals) - Records, Distinct <code field>, Total <measure>

.report-block Analytics: .chart-grid of .chart cards (.chart__head title + '8 / 24' count + Show all toggle, .chart__body scrollable, .bar rows with .bar__label / .bar__track / .bar__fill / .bar__value, 'Other (n)' muted bar, Numeric totals chart with 3 maroon tints)

.report-block Data: count chip, columns-shown chip, .search, .table-wrap .data-table #repGrid with sticky last column (row menu Edit this record / Open data entry), has-error rows with title tooltip, tfoot totals, .results__foot with page size and .pager
.empty no-data state with Start submission CTA, .toast-host
strengths: One page serves all 46 datasets: charts chosen from the first coded fields, measure detection filters out ID-like numerics so totals are meaningful
Show all / Show top 8 with an 'Other' bucket keeps charts bounded; chart body has a fixed height so cards align
Grid search spans every field and code description; totals row and row count follow the filter ('Total (4 matching)')
Sticky action column keeps the edit affordance reachable while the table scrolls sideways; RTL flips it to the left
Export writes the dataset under database column names so it round-trips through upload
Honest empty state that explains what will appear once records exist
weaknesses: Single dataset, single institution, current draft only; no period-over-period trend, no cross-dataset or sector view, no KHDA aggregate
Bars have no axes or scale labels (same defect the competitor has); no chart type beyond horizontal bars
Chart fields are picked heuristically (first 3 coded fields, first measure) with no user control, saved views, or filters
No data-quality or compliance metrics (rule pass rates, timeliness, freshness), no validation summary, no board-pack / PDF export
Styling hooks are IDs (#repGrid, #repBody) rather than classes, so the sticky-column table cannot be reused on a new page without CSS changes
Distinct-count tiles on unique-key fields (e.g. 'Distinct academic period 24' equal to the record count) are noise
Export depends on CDN SheetJS; report has no print stylesheet
